required_seams.action: In Golden mode do not consult these obsolete PS2RNA literals or route audio through their logging-only/constant-zero unsupported-method bodies. Bind the real Golden/native output path, format/state/buffer lifecycle, rendering, underrun/device errors and cleanup. Removing old warnings is not permission to suppress native failures or fake device/query success. Original PS2 mode retains its original guard, logs and return behavior.
All translated/native/inlined paths require GoldenM6b runtime qualification. NSO and private analysis artifacts are static evidence only, never runtime dependencies.
